title: workspace.execute
description: Run a command in the project, in the sandbox the request names (daemon.py, shell_exec.py, sandbox.py). A request without `sandbox` is read as `{"mode": "host"}`, so the daemon's FABRIQUE_SANDBOX_REQUIRED raises it to its mode (`forced_by_daemon` in the reply's `sandbox`) or, when that mode cannot run, refuses it (`error`); never the host. A command that could not run is an observation in the reply (`error`), not a refusal.

sandbox.description: Where the command runs. Absent: host, which the daemon's floor raises.

purpose.description: test, install, check or assistant (a console assistant's consultation); anything else reads as test.

env.description: Variable names only; the values come from the daemon's own environment.

sandbox.description: What the daemon applied: present when the request named a sandbox, and whenever the floor moved the command off the host.
